source.sourceNote: This manifest records architecture/capability patterns to evaluate and adapt. It does not copy HyperSwitch implementation code or assert conformance to payment-network rules.

capabilities.adaptation: Map payment-routing orchestration to ADMIT -> NORMALIZE -> QUOTIENT -> INSTANTIATE -> EXECUTE -> COMPARE -> FALSIFY -> REPLAY -> CERTIFY.
Use Floot scheduled/background jobs and durable Postgres state; GitHub Actions handles compute-heavy fan-out where appropriate.

capabilities.sourcePattern: card_metadata crate and embedded canonical configuration
capabilities.adaptation: Extend existing official-BIN records with canonical card subtype/product metadata, provenance, source digest, validity interval, and admission state.
Represent EMV/kernel/terminal/reference executors as typed adapters with capability declarations, versions, evidence requirements, and deterministic input/output contracts.
Route a verification object to admissible executors/test suites based on scheme, protocol phase, card metadata, evidence strength, and capability compatibility.
Retries are for verification jobs only; every attempt receives an ordinal, seed/input digest, executor version, and reason. No uncontrolled infinite retry.
Emit admitted, instantiated, started, step, divergence, replayed, falsified, certified, and rejected events with immutable correlation IDs and hashes.
Add signed outbound verification events for long-running jobs, never including PAN/credentials; support replay-safe event IDs and verification of signatures.
Bind command identity to verificationObjectId + inputDigest + policyVersion + executorVersion; duplicate commands resolve to the existing run.
Reconcile declared source evidence, generated fixture, execution ledger, reference executor, replay result, and certificate; report missing/mismatched edges rather than silently repairing them.

capabilities.sourcePattern: OTLP traces, Prometheus metrics, Loki logs, Tempo traces
capabilities.adaptation: Use structured metrics/logs/traces around every command and executor attempt; keep observability replaceable and never make it an authority source.
Keep all test card material synthetic. Model a vault boundary only as a verification interface; never import or persist live PAN/payment credentials.
Add 3DS/authentication as a separate deterministic protocol domain with explicit state transitions and evidence contracts; do not claim production authentication.
Add bounded anti-abuse/adversarial fixtures and negative tests to verify rejection paths, rate/attempt policies, and safety gates.
Model metadata changes as versioned transformations requiring re-admission and re-verification; never mutate a previously certified object in place.
Normalize imported public evidence/configuration into versioned, hashed, schema-validated records before admission.
Track executor time, queue time, retries, artifact size, test cardinality, quotient reduction, divergence rate, and evidence completeness.
Do not add replication solely for feature parity. Floot Postgres is sufficient until measured read/write pressure requires it.
Prefer Floot-managed background/scheduled jobs first. Add Redis only if measured queue semantics/throughput justify the dependency.

verificationExtensions.paymentApprovalRule: paymentDecision MUST remain NOT_EVALUATED in the verification lab
